title: Risk-Based Model Routing Cost Gate
domain: Coding-agent task routing by risk, ambiguity, and scope
mission: Lower expected model cost while preserving clarification, quality, and safety boundaries.
outcome: A field-based policy clears held-out routes and a response-bound 36-run cost gate.
verificationGates: npm run verify:exercise checks protected inputs, implementation quality, and required submission evidence.
agentWorkflow: Collect three runs for every eligible lane.
Grade and bind every raw response.
Use the protected scorer and adopt only when all gates pass.
Capture comparable before and after results using the conditions defined in the exercise README.
masterySignals: High risk never downgrades for savings.
Failed calls are charged before escalation.
Savings and quality come from repeated measurements.
